product_summary: 20 Microns Ltd is an ultrafine industrial minerals and specialty chemicals producer (not a construction/DIY company). Website product portfolio (20microns.com, homepage 'Product Portfolio') lists: Industrial Minerals — anti-block additives, aqueous co-thickener, attapulgite, ball clay, barium carbonate, barrier fillers, barytes, bentonite, bleaching earth, calcined alumina, calcined kaolin, calcium carbonate, diatomaceous earth, dolomite, feldspar, fullers earth, HSCAS, hydrated lime, hydrous kaolin, LCM (lost circulation material), magnesium sulphate anhydrous, mica, perlite, ramming mass, silica, talc, wollastonite. Specialty Chemicals — magnesium oxide activators, aluminium silicate, ATPGEL, coloured quartz, AR mica, desiccants, DIATOFIL 570, flame retardants/smoke suppressants, fumed silica, Hypertherm, mullite, organoclay rheological additive, precipitated silica, rheology modifier, eco green filler, synthetic barium sulphate, titanium dioxide (white/buff/grey), wax & wax additives, white pigment opacifier, zinc oxide. Advanced Materials — graphene, graphite. Markets served: paints & coatings, plastics, rubber, paper, oil & gas drilling, foundry, ceramics, agrochemicals, cosmetics, animal feed, detergents, edible oil refining, welding electrodes, adhesives, brake composites, textiles.
role_hint: manufacturer (own mines and plants, e.g. Alwar plant; vertically integrated mineral producer) — no trader signs found on the site
comment: Declared codes 2511.10 (barytes), 2518.20 (calcined dolomite), 2526.20 (talc), 2529.10 (feldspar) are all genuinely in the portfolio — exact matches for those four lines. However the declaration covers only 4 of ~50 product lines and misses the company's core revenue minerals: bentonite (2508.10), kaolin/ball clay/fullers earth (2507.00), calcium carbonate (2836.50), mica (2525.20), wollastonite (2529.30), perlite (2530.10), diatomite (2512.00), bleaching earth (3802.90), plus the entire specialty-chemicals range (titanium dioxide 2823.00, zinc oxide 2817.00, precipitated/fumed silica 2811.22, barium carbonate 2836.60, magnesium sulphate 2833.29, organoclay/rheology modifiers 3824.99, wax 2712.90, graphene/graphite 3801/2504). Industry classification 'Строительство и DIY' is a misclassification: the company is an industrial-minerals/specialty-chemicals manufacturer supplying paints, plastics, rubber, paper, drilling and foundry — construction chemicals is only one of ~20 end markets. HS mismatch is not a rejection ground (Rule 3): company retained, declared codes corrected/expanded to the actual portfolio. All product lines above are taken from the company's own website catalogue and are therefore 'заявлено, не подтверждено' — no customs line was checked in this task (registry/customs research out of scope). Note: some HS-6 assignments above are my mapping of the product name to the tariff (e.g. perlite→2530.10, diatomite→2512.00, calcined alumina→2519.90); they should be confirmed against the actual shipping documents before being written into the database.
